Name: Immersive Catalogues - A Furniture Progression Mod (Craftable Furniture)
Author: Jeahnoh
Description:
[b]Immersive Catalogues: A Furniture Progression Mod (Craftable Furniture)
[/b][b]Stop Buying. Start Building.

[/b]Stardew Valley is a game about crafting, gathering, and building a life from scratch. So why does the furniture system feel like a creative mode cheat code?

[b]Immersive Catalogues[/b] completely reimagines how you decorate your farmhouse. Instead of buying a magical book on a stand that gives you infinite items for free, this mod integrates [b]400+ Furniture Items[/b] into the actual gameplay loop.
If you want a wood chair, you need wood. If you want a plush couch, you need cloth. If you want a plasma TV, you need iridium and batteries.
[b]

✨ Features[/b][b]🔨 The Furniture Workbench
[/b]
A brand new, heavy-duty drafting station used to craft your designs.

[list]
[*][b]Cost:[/b] 200 Wood.
[*][b]Function:[/b] Acts as the central hub for all your furniture crafting needs.
[*][b]Immersive Sprite:[/b] A custom-designed, drafting table that fits perfectly in your workshop or shed.
[/list][b]🪑 400+ Crafting Recipes
[/b]
Nearly every piece of furniture from the Catalogue and Carpenter's Shop is now craftable, balanced to be fair but rewarding.

[list]
[*][b]Essentials:[/b] Use your early game Wood and Sap to build basic chairs and tables.
[*][b]Domestic:[/b] Upgrade to Cloth and Wool to craft sofas and armchairs.
[*][b]Lighting:[/b] Use Iron, Copper, and Batteries to craft lamps and windows.
[*][b]Themed Sets:[/b] End-game recipes for Joja, Junimo, Retro, and Wizard styles.
[/list]

[b]⚠️ What's Not Included (Yet)

[/b]While this mod covers over 95% of the furniture in the game, a few specific items have been intentionally excluded in V1.0.0:

[list]
[*][b]Progression Rewards:[/b] Items normally earned through Museum donations, 14-Heart events, or Festivals (e.g., [i]Singing Stone[/i], [i]Leah's Sculpture[/i]) are not craftable to preserve their rarity and value in the game loop.
[*][b]Technical Exclusions:[/b] A small handful of items (specifically [i]Floor Dividers[/i] and certain [i]wall decorations[/i]) are currently disabled due to ID definition issues. These will be added in a future update!
[/list][list]
[/list][b]📂 Organized Categories
[/b]
Powered by [b]Better Crafting[/b], the Workbench features a custom UI with 6 organized tabs so you never have to scroll endlessly:

[list=1]
[*][b]Carpenter's Basics:[/b] The essentials to get you started.

[*][b]Domestic:[/b] Soft seating and beds for a cozy home.

[*][b]Surfaces:[/b] Tables, desks, and storage.

[*][b]Architecture:[/b] Windows, fireplaces, and lighting.

[*][b]Decor:[/b] Plants, rugs, and clutter to add life to your rooms.

[*][b]Themed Sets:[/b] Matching sets for specific aesthetics (Retro, Joja, etc.).

[/list][b]
📥 Installation

[/b][list=1]
[*][b]Install SMAPI[/b] (Latest Version).

[*][b]Install Content Patcher.[/b]

[*][b]Install Better Crafting[/b] (Required for the menu).

[*]Download [b]Immersive Catalogues[/b].

[*]Unzip into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder.


[/list][b]Usage:
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Craft the [b]Furniture Workbench[/b] from your crafting menu (requires 200 Wood).

[*]Place it down.

[*][b]Right-Click[/b] the workbench to open the new crafting interface.

[/list][b]
🔮 Future Plans

[/b][list]
[*][b]V1.1:[/b] Configuration options to disable/nerf the vanilla Furniture Catalogue. General Recipe tweaks.
[*][b]V1.2(?):[/b] Wallpaper and Flooring Support (Recipes and replacement w/o deleting).
[/list][list]
[*][b][/b][b]V1.3(?):[/b] Support for additional modded furniture sets (likely via optional add-on packs).
[/list]

[b]🤖 AI Transparency Note

[/b][i]I believe AI can be a great tool for developers when used responsibly. Gemini AI was used as a sounding board for initial conceptualization, debugging, and general project planning. However, all actual implementation - including the code, sprite work, balancing, data entry, and the mod banner - was 100% handcrafted by me.


[/i][list]
[/list][b]Credits

[/b][list]
[*][b]Author:[/b] Jeahnoh
[*][b]Frameworks:[/b] Built using Content Patcher and Better Crafting.
[/list]
